definitions.explanation: Having a short lifespan. Used for people, animals, products, organizations, or anything that does not last long.

examples.japanese: {短命|たんめい}な⟦{政権|せいけん}→政権：12883_seiken⟧だった。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{短命|たんめい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{一週間|いっしゅうかん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧しか⟦{生|い}きられない→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧。
examples.english: This insect is short-lived and can only live for one week.

examples.japanese: {短命|たんめい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧⟦{新商品|しんしょうひん}→新商品：11504_shinshouhin⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{少|すく}なくない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
examples.english: There are quite a few new products that were short-lived.

notes:
Describes something with a short lifespan or duration. Can refer to people, animals, products, governments, or trends. Functions as both a noun and a na-adjective.

FORMS:
⟦{短|たん}→短〜：03959_tan⟧ (short) + {命|めい} (life, fate).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {短命|たんめい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{終|お}わる: to be short-lived
- {短命|たんめい}な⟦{政権|せいけん}→政権：12883_seiken⟧: short-lived administration
- {短命|たんめい}⟦{内閣|ないかく}→内閣：04800_naikaku⟧: short-lived cabinet
- {短命|たんめい}な⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧: short-lived product

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{長命|ちょうめい}→長命：22138_choumei⟧: long-lived (direct opposite)
- ⟦{長寿|ちょうじゅ}→長寿：14478_chouju⟧: longevity (more positive, celebratory nuance)
